import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_87/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_87/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_87/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_87/test_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_87/test_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_87/test_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_87/test_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_87/test_7.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_87/test_8.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_87/test_9.csv"
    ]

    # Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        # Ensure schema correctness and types
        df = df[['admit', 'gre', 'gpa', 'prestige']]  # enforce column order and presence
        df['admit'] = df['admit'].astype(int)
        df['gre'] = df['gre'].astype(int)
        df['gpa'] = df['gpa'].astype(float)
        df['prestige'] = df['prestige'].astype(int)
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source DataFrames vertically (union all rows)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # The target schema is the same as source schema, so no further transformation needed.
    # However, to ensure the final DataFrame matches the target schema exactly, enforce dtypes again:
    combined_df = combined_df.astype({
        'admit': 'int',
        'gre': 'int',
        'gpa': 'float',
        'prestige': 'int'
    })

    # Save the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_87/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
